verified_facts.text: Merrywing Bay is a stretch of beach directly in front of the resort, known for calm waters, golden sand and sunsets.
verified_facts.excerpt: A tranquil stretch of beach located directly in front of Aurora Anguilla. Known for its calm waters, golden sand, and stunning sunsets

verified_facts.text: Rendezvous Bay looks across the channel to St. Martin.
verified_facts.excerpt: Famous for its turquoise waters and breathtaking views of St. Martin across the channel

verified_facts.text: Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport (AXA) is located minutes from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anguilla’s main airport, located just minutes from Aurora Anguilla.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a waterpark with slides and a lazy river.
verified_facts.excerpt: waterpark with slides and a lazy river

verified_facts.text: The resort's golf club has a Greg Norman Signature Design 18-hole International Course and a 9-hole short course, Avalon Links.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aurora International Golf Club’s stunning Greg Norman Signature Design 18-hole International Course and 9-hole short course, Avalon Links

verified_facts.text: The International Course is par 72 and 7,165 yards.
verified_facts.excerpt: PAR 72 \| 7,165 YARDS

verified_facts.text: The International Course's 18th hole begins with a tee shot over a salt pond and climbs forty feet to a green guarded by three bunkers.
verified_facts.excerpt: It begins with a demanding tee shot over the salt pond, followed by an ascent of forty feet to reach a narrow green meticulously guarded by three imposing bunkers.

verified_facts.text: The golf academy has two instructional bays with Trackman simulators.
verified_facts.excerpt: With two instructional bays equipped with Trackman simulators

verified_facts.text: Menus draw on the resort's 10,000-square-foot hydroponic gardens, which supply produce, herbs and fruit every day.
verified_facts.excerpt: our 10,000-square-foot hydroponic gardens. These gardens provide fresh produce, herbs, and fruits every day.

verified_facts.text: The resort has six diverse dining options ranging from casual to upscale.
verified_facts.excerpt: six diverse dining opportunities, each offering a different experience from casual to upscale

verified_facts.text: Chef's Table serves family-style feasts prepared in an open kitchen and wood-burning oven.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fresh-baked pastries and family-style feasts prepared in an open kitchen and wood-burning oven

verified_facts.text: D Richard's is a steakhouse located at the Aurora International Golf Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located at the Aurora International Golf Club, D Richards is the best (and only) steakhouse in Anguilla.

verified_facts.text: Tokyo Bay is Executive Chef Joe Richardson's modern take on classic Japanese cuisine, with sushi and sashimi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Executive Chef Joe Richardson whose deep respect and study of Japanese culture inspired this authentic, modern take on classic Japanese cuisine. Explore a robust menu of fresh sushi and sashimi

verified_facts.text: Sole di Mare serves Mediterranean dishes including handmade pastas and pizzas, with views of the sea and Saint Martin.
verified_facts.excerpt: From handmade pastas and pizzas to vibrant dishes inspired by the South of France, Greece, Spain, and Morocco

verified_facts.text: A new beach club is due to debut in November 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: A New Beachfront Icon Debuts November 2026

verified_facts.text: Sorana Spa has twelve treatment rooms, including two couples suites, with views of Rendezvous Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our twelve treatment rooms include two couples suites and a custom-designed with a sand quartz table made for specific treatments. With luxurious facilities and views of Rendezvous Beach

verified_facts.text: Sorana Spa offers steam, sauna and hydrotherapy experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: spa amenities include a co-ed relaxation, steam, sauna, and hydrotherapy experiences

verified_facts.text: All non-motorized watersport rentals are complimentary and available daily at Rendezvous Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: all non-motorized watersport rentals are complimentary and available daily at Rendezvous Beach

verified_facts.text: The Aurora Explorers Club offers supervised activities for young guests, including arts and crafts, games and storytelling.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Aurora Explorers Club invites young guests to discover, create, and connect through a thoughtfully curated program of supervised activities

verified_facts.text: The pool complex has a splash pad, zero-entry pool, lazy river, slide tower and cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The stunning family-friendly pool complex features a splash pad, zero entry pool, lazy river, slide tower, and private and family cabanas.

verified_facts.text: The Aurora Entertainment Park includes a tennis center, pickleball courts, a climbing wall, beach volleyball, clay bocce, basketball courts and a 9-hole mini golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: The new Aurora Entertainment Park features a world-class tennis center, pickleball courts, climbing wall, beach volleyball, clay bocce, basketball courts, and a 9-hole mini golf course.

verified_facts.text: Guided cave tours are run in partnership with the Anguilla National Trust and Katouche Tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: guided cave tour, presented in partnership with the Anguillan National Trust and Katouche Tours

verified_facts.text: Accommodations include luxury rooms, suites, villas and estate homes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take your pick from Luxury Rooms, Suites, Villas, and Estate Homes.

verified_facts.text: Estate guests have private swimming pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Estate guests can lounge by their private swimming pools

verified_facts.text: Forbes Travel Guide gave the resort a 4 Star designation in 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: 4 Star Designation 2025- Aurora Anguilla Resort & Golf Club

verified_facts.text: The Caribbean Travel Awards named the resort Caribbean Golf Resort of the Year in 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Caribbean Travel Awards - “Caribbean Golf Resort of the Year”

verified_facts.text: Anguilla has daily direct commercial flights from Miami with American Airlines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Direct commercial flights are available daily through Miami (MIA) to Anguilla (AXA) with American Airlines.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers water transfer options to and from St. Maarten.
verified_facts.excerpt: WATER TRANSFER OPTIONS TO AND FROM ST. MAARTEN
